title: PRAY THIS SUNDAY MORNING PRAYER BEFORE 7AM
text: Father, I thank you. I thank you for every single person under the sound of my voice right now. I thank you that your name is glorified. I thank you that we are gathered in this atmosphere of divine presence. But before we go anywhere, there is something the spirit of God is saying to me at this very moment. There is someone, yes, someone listening to this right now. The Lord says your name is written in the book of life, but your destiny requires the fire of prayer. The enemy has created a fog around your vision, a fog, but the Lord says not today, not in this season. I speak to the spirit of confusion right now. Scatter. I command you to scatter in the name of Jesus. Let me tell you something. Psalm 27:10, when your mother and father forsake you, the Lord will take you up. But here is what I am feeling. There are foundations that have been laid against your life. Altars, evil altars speaking your name, speaking your defeat, speaking your limitation. And the spirit of God is saying to me this morning you will not leave this place the same way you came. This is your sign. This is your sign to wake up. Do you understand? Wake up, not just physically, spiritually. There is a dimension of prayer that many believers have forgotten. There is a dimension of intercession, of travail, of aggressive warfare that the body of Christ has abandoned, but not you. The fact that you are here, the fact that you are listening, the spirit of God is saying this is deliberate. This is appointed. This is your season to move from prayer of petition into prayer of power, from asking to decreeing, from supplication to warfare. Listen carefully. Ephesians 6:12-18, Paul tells us our warfare is not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against spiritual wickedness in high places. But so many of us we are wrestling with people. We are wrestling with our neighbors. We are wrestling with situations. Do you understand the deception? The real battle is not where you think it is. The real battle is in the heavenlies. The real battle is in the realm of the spirit. And when you take up your position there, when you begin to pray with authority, with revelation, with fire, everything else falls into place. I am stirring your spirit right now. I am speaking to the deep places in you. The places where faith has been shaken, where hope has been deferred, where you have been waiting for a breakthrough that seems never to come. The Lord is saying the breakthrough is not delayed. It is strategic. God is positioning you. God is separating you from the mixture. God is preparing you for a dimension of blessing that your mind cannot even comprehend right now. But it requires this. It requires aggressive prayer. It requires that you become fierce in the spirit. That you do not negotiate with darkness. That you do not tolerate the voice of the enemy speaking into your life, into your family, into your business, into your health. No, you rise up. You take authority. You declare the word of the Lord. Someone is hearing this and your marriage needs resurrection. Yes, your marriage, there is a wound there. There is a breach. There is an attack that has been relentless. The enemy speaking separation into your union, shame into your home, but the spirit of God says not on my watch. I decree and declare by the power of the blood of Jesus Christ, every demonic assignment sent to destroy marriages under the sound of my voice, catch fire. Catch fire now. Let the blood of Jesus stand between you and every accusation, between you and every deception that the enemy is trying to plant in your home. I speak covenant strength. I speak divine connection. I speak that you will look at your spouse and see not the failure of yesterday, but the grace of today and the glory of tomorrow. There is a woman in this place, perhaps in Lagos, perhaps in Abuja, the Lord is saying your womb is opening. The medical reports lied. The doctor spoke absence, but the God we serve speaks creation. I speak the activation of your womb. I speak the breaking of every curse spoken over your lineage. I speak that you shall conceive and bear a child that will shake nations, that will carry the purpose of God. And you, the man hearing this, your financial gates have been locked. There has been an embargo on your increase. Promotion has been withheld. Contracts have fallen through. Opportunities that should have been yours have been stolen. But listen to me. I break that embargo now. I speak to every principality assigned to lock your finances, fall down. Fall down in the name of Jesus. I decree that the windows of heaven are opening over your life, that a blessing is coming that there will not be room enough to receive it. That you will be a conduit of blessing, blessing to your family, blessing to your nation, blessing to the kingdom of God. There are dimensions to this warfare prayer that we must go into. Dimensions. You see, prayer is not just words. Prayer is power. Prayer is positioning. Prayer is partnership with the throne of God. When you pray, you are not sending messages to heaven hoping God will hear you. No, you are aligning yourself with the will and the purpose that God has already decreed. You are agreeing with what has already been established in the realm of the spirit. You are releasing that reality into the visible realm where you live. Thus said the spirit of God this morning, there is a generation that will not negotiate with darkness anymore. There is a generation that will not live in fear. There is a generation that will rise up and take dominion. And if you are here, if you are listening, you are part of that generation. You are called to be a voice. You are called to be a standard. You are called to be someone through whom God's power flows without reservation. Let me open the scripture again. 2 Timothy 1:7-8, for God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. But notice it says we have been given. It is not something we are waiting to receive. It is already ours. We have been given power. We have been given a sound mind. We have been given the capacity to love in the midst of hatred, to hope in the midst of despair, to declare in the midst of silence. And yet so many of us are living beneath what has already been given to us. We are like princes living like paupers. We are like heirs refusing the inheritance, but not anymore. Not from this moment forward. I am declaring over your life, receive what is yours. Take hold of the authority that is yours. Stand in the power that has already been deposited in your spirit. You are not powerless. You are not hopeless. You are not the victim of your circumstances. You are the victor. You are the overcomer. You are more than a conqueror through him that loved you. Now, let us enter into prayer. I want you to understand something. The next portion of this ministration, this is where real breakthrough happens. This is where declarations are made. This is where the atmosphere shifts. This is where angels move. This is where assignments against your life are broken. Listen to me. I want you to pray with ferocity. I want you to pray like your life depends on it. Because it does. Father God, I come before your throne this morning in the authority of the name of Jesus. I come claiming the blood. I come claiming the victory. I come claiming the power that has already been released through the cross and through the resurrection. And I speak for every person under the sound of my voice. I speak their restoration. I speak their deliverance. I speak their breakthrough. Let every evil altar that has been erected against these people, let fire fall upon it. Let fire fall. Let those altars be broken. Let those altars crumble to dust. Every witch doctor, every sorcerer, every agent of darkness that has been assigned to these people, I command you to release them now. I command you to take your hands off them. The blood of Jesus speaks a better word than the blood of goats and bulls. The blood of Jesus invalidates every claim of darkness. Someone is hearing this and there is witchcraft in your bloodline, a family curse, something that has been passed down. It has weakened you. It has limited you. It has stolen from you. It has delayed you. But the spirit of God is saying today is the day of breaking. Today is the day of reversal. I decree and declare that every ancestral curse is broken, that every demonic inheritance is revoked, that you are born again, that you are a new creation. All things have passed away. All things have become new. That old covenant with darkness is nullified by the new covenant with the blood of Jesus. There is a woman hearing this right now and you have been fighting a spirit of barrenness. It is not just physical. It is spiritual. Something has been assigned to keep you empty, to keep you waiting, to keep you in a season that God did not ordain. But I declare this morning that your season is changing. I decree that the Lord opens every gate, every reproductive gate, every creative gate, every gate of blessing. And you shall be full. You shall be satisfied. You shall look at what God has done in your life and you shall say surely goodness and mercy have followed me all the days of my life. Psalm 23:6, "Goodness and mercy shall follow you, not chase you, follow you like a hound, like a pursuer." Everywhere you go, goodness is going. Everywhere you go, blessing is going, but you have to believe it. You have to declare it. You have to take your position in it. If you are still thinking like a victim, you will live like a victim. If you are still speaking like a defeated person, you will manifest defeat. But, if you rise up and declare your victory, if you prophesy over your own life, if you take authority in Jesus' name, everything shifts. I want to speak to something that the spirit of God is laying on my heart heavily. There are men in this place who have been emasculated spiritually. Your leadership has been challenged. Your authority in your homes has been undermined. The enemy has made you question your calling, your capacity, your anointing. But, the spirit of God is raising you back up. I speak to the spirit of a man within you. I speak resurrection to your purpose. I speak activation to your anointing. I speak boldness to your spirit. You are called to be a priest in your home. You are called to intercede for your family. You are called to stand in the gap. Do not shrink back. Do not be ashamed. Rise up and take your place. Deuteronomy 28:1-14, the blessings of obedience are described there. If you obey the voice of the Lord, you will be blessed coming in, blessed going out. Your enemies will flee before you in seven ways. But, then verses 15 onward, the causes of disobedience. Now, listen to me carefully. Many of the attacks against us are not random. They are not accidental. They are consequences of old disobedience, agreements we made, words we spoke, decisions we made in darkness that opened a door. And until we deal with those doors, until we repent, until we break those agreements, we will continue to suffer the consequences. This is why I'm calling you to aggressive prayer this morning. Not prayer that is passive, not prayer that is timid, prayer that is fierce, prayer that is bold. Prayer that declares, "I am shutting every door that I opened to darkness. Every agreement I made with the enemy, I revoke it." Every word I spoke that gave the enemy an entrance, I renounce it. Everything I did in the darkness, I bring to the light, and I ask for forgiveness. And I stand on the blood of Jesus. There is someone and you have been in a cycle, the same failure repeating itself, the same defeat recurring, the same pattern of loss and disappointment. You break that cycle today. I speak the breaking of generational cycles. I speak the breaking of personal patterns. I speak that you are walking into a new season, a new level, a new dimension of God's purpose for your life. Let me pray this. Father, I ask you right now, release the angels of breakthrough over these people, release the angels of restoration, release the angels of divine acceleration, send forth Michael to break the assignments of the enemy. Let Michael arise. Let him take his sword and cut the cords that have bound your children. Let him separate the assignments from the assign. Let him stand guard over marriages, over finances, over health, over destinies. Someone is hearing this and sickness has attacked your body, disease. It came to steal from you. It came to wear you down. But, the spirit of God is saying right now, the disease is broken. The sickness loses its grip. By the stripes of Jesus, you are healed. Not you will be healed. You are healed. It is past tense. It is done. Receive it. I decree wholeness. I decree restoration of health. I decree that no plague shall come near your dwelling, that you shall live long on the earth, that you shall fulfill your days, that you shall see your children and your children's children. Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that heals you." Healing is his name. Healing is his character. Healing is his nature. If you believe it, if you confess it, if you position yourself in it, you will walk in it. But, you have to let go of the sickness mentality. You have to let go of the disease identity. You cannot say, "I am sick" and expect healing. You have to say, "I am healed. I am whole. I am strong." The life of God flows through me. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost, and in this temple, disease has no place. Sickness has no authority. Death has no dominion. I speak to someone's destiny right now. Your destiny has been delayed. That is not a guess. That is a knowing. Something has been holding you back, a fear, a trauma, a failure, an assignment, a word spoken, a decision made. But, the spirit of God is saying your time has come. Your season is now. I decree the acceleration of your destiny. I speak that all the time you have lost comes back to you sevenfold. All the years that the locust has eaten, God will restore. Your latter days shall be greater than your former days. Listen to me. Joel 2:24-25, "The threshing floor shall be full of wheat and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil, and I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten." Do you know what that means? It means God is not just going to take you forward. He's going to restore what was stolen. He's going to make up for lost time. He's going to compress years into moments. He's going to multiply what was lost. Someone is saying, "But, my situation is too big. But, my problem is too large. But, I have made too many mistakes. But, I have been too far gone." And the spirit of God is saying, "None of that changes who I am. None of that limits my power. None of that prevents my purpose. I am not limited by your past. I am not constrained by your mistakes. I am the God who raises the dead. I am the God who creates out of nothing. I am the God who makes a way where there is no way." There is a young person hearing this. Your future is being attacked right now. Pipelines of provision are being blocked. Doors are being closed. Relationships are being broken. The enemy is trying to steal your future before you even get there. But, I am standing in the gap for you. I decree that your future is sealed. Your future is protected. Your future is preserved. Every door that should open for you, open. Every gate that should unlock, unlock. Every blessing that is yours by covenant, manifest now. 1 Corinthians 2:9, "Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor has it entered into the heart of man, the things that God has prepared for those that love him." Your future is greater than your imagination. Your destiny is beyond what you can dream. But, it requires that you take your place in prayer, that you take your position of authority, that you declare the word of the Lord. Now, I want to speak to time. Time is a weapon. The enemy steals time. He creates delays. He manufactures seasons of waiting that God never ordained. But, I speak to time this morning. Time, you will accelerate over the lives of these people. Time, you will compress over their blessings. Time, you will move according to the purpose of God. I break every time assignment that has been placed against these people. I speak the acceleration of divine timing. What should take 5 years, God will do it in 5 months. What should take 5 months, God will do it in 5 weeks. This is the season of divine acceleration. Someone is hearing this and your virtue has been stolen, your strength, your vigor, your essence. Something or someone has drained you. But, I declare the restoration of your virtue. I decree that the Lord restores to you double. I speak that you arise with greater strength than before, that you run and do not grow weary, that you walk and do not faint, that the joy of the Lord becomes your strength. Nehemiah 8:10, "The joy of the Lord is your strength." Not happiness, joy. The kind of joy that comes from knowing that God is in control, that God is good, that God has already won. That kind of joy is your fortress. That kind of joy is your weapon. That kind of joy will sustain you when everything else fails. Let me speak a prophetic word right now. There is a dimension that God is opening up, a spiritual dimension, a prophetic dimension, a dimension where the veil is thin and the realm of the spirit is tangible, and God is calling forth prophets. He's calling forth seers. He's calling forth people who will carry his word. If you are one of those people, if the spirit of God is stirring in you, awakening that prophetic gift, this is your season. I release you into your calling. I anoint you for the office. I decree that your words will carry weight. Your words will carry authority. Your words will change atmospheres. There is someone and you have been silent when you should have been speaking. You have been hidden when you should have been visible. You have been small when you should have been great. But, the spirit of God is bringing you into prominence. I decree visibility. I decree platform. I decree that your gift will be recognized and rewarded, that you will stand in places you never dreamed, that you will speak words that change nations. Jeremiah 1:17-19, "Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you, and before you were born, I set you apart. I appointed you as a prophet to the nations. Do you know who you are? Do you know what you are called to? You are not just a believer, you are a voice. You are an instrument. You are someone through whom God speaks. And if you have been held back, if you have been silent, today you break loose. Today you step into your call. Father God, I ask that you cover these people. Cover them with your presence. Cover them with your power. Cover them with your blessing. I ask that you send forth your spirit to confirm what has been spoken. I ask that every word spoken in faith this morning becomes manifested reality in the lives of these people. I decree that signs follow. I decree that wonders are released. I decree that healing happens, that deliverance happens, that breakthrough happens. I speak to the spirit of fear right now. Fear of failure, fear of rejection, fear of the unknown, fear of what men will say, fear of losing what you have, fear of not getting what you need. Spirit of fear, I command you out. I command you to release your grip. I declare that perfect love casts out all fear, and the love of God is perfect. The love of God is complete. The love of God covers everything. Someone is in debt, financial bondage. It is a weight on your spirit. It is a burden on your mind. It has stolen your peace. But the spirit of God is saying your deliverance is coming. I decree the breaking of financial chains. I decree that your creditors will release you, that debts will be canceled, that the blessing of God will be so abundant that you will not only be debt free, you will be wealthy. You will be a lender, not a borrower. Deuteronomy 15:6. The Lord your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations, but will borrow from none. That is your inheritance. That is your covenant right. But it requires that you take your position, that you pray, that you declare, that you believe. There is a family and there is division. There is a breach. There is a rift that has separated you. The enemy has done this. The enemy has whispered. The enemy has created suspicion. But I decree family restoration. I decree that hearts are healed, that understanding comes, that reconciliation happens, that love is restored, that you sit at the table together again, that you laugh together again, that you are knit together again. I want to speak to the spirit of offense. Offense is a weapon that the enemy uses constantly. Someone has hurt you. Someone has disappointed you. Someone has betrayed you, and you have taken offense. That offense has hardened your heart. That offense has closed your spirit. But the spirit of God is asking you to release it, to let it go, to forgive. Not because what they did was right, but because you cannot carry it any longer. Forgiveness is not for them. Forgiveness is for you. It is freedom for you. Matthew 18:35. This is how my heavenly father would treat each of you, unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart. Unforgiveness is a door. It is an open gate. It allows the enemy access to your life. But when you forgive, when you truly forgive, you close that gate. You lock that door. You say no more access. Someone is hearing this, and you are in a season of waiting. Nothing is moving. Everything feels stalled. You have been waiting for so long that you are tired of waiting. But the spirit of God is saying your waiting is almost over. Your breakthrough is at the door. I decree that what you have been waiting for arrives suddenly. That what has been delayed comes suddenly. That what has been promised manifests suddenly. The suddenly of God is your portion. Habakkuk 2:3. The vision awaits an appointed time. It hastens toward the fulfillment. It will not prove false. If it seems slow, wait for it. It will surely come. Do not worry about the timeline. Do you understand me? Do not worry about when. Your responsibility is to believe. Your responsibility is to pray. Your responsibility is to declare. God's responsibility is the timing. Let me release a declaration. I speak to principalities and powers right now. I speak to spiritual wickedness in high places. I speak to every demonic assignment, every altar, every covenant made in darkness. I bring the blood of Jesus between you and these people. The blood of Jesus is a barrier. The blood of Jesus is a wall. The blood of Jesus is an eternal security. You cannot cross it. You cannot breach it. You cannot overcome it. Someone is hearing this, and you have been bound, bound by shame, bound by guilt, bound by the mistakes of your past, bound by the words that were spoken over you, bound by the predictions of failure. But I break those bonds right now. I decree your freedom. I decree that you are no longer bound, that you are released, that you are let go, that you step into a new identity, the identity that God has for you, not the identity that the enemy has assigned. 2 Corinthians 5:17. Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. Old things are passed away. Behold, all things have become new. That is your reality. That is your truth. That is what God declares about you. If you are in Christ, you are new. Everything about you that was old is done. Everything about you that was broken is healed. Everything about you that was defeated is victorious. There is a marriage that is on the edge, that is fractured, that is hanging by a thread, and the enemy is pushing for the final break. But I decree preservation. I decree that your marriage is saved. I decree that your union is restored. I decree that the love that once was comes back stronger, that you remember why you said yes, that you choose each other again and again. Song of Songs 2:16. My beloved is mine, and I am his. That is the language of covenant. That is the language of belonging. That is the language of security in union. If your marriage is struggling right now, if it is being attacked, I am decreeing that you take that language, and you speak it over your union. You belong to each other. You are committed to each other. You will walk through this. Someone is hearing this, and you have been isolated. You have been made to feel alone. The enemy has whispered that no one cares, that no one sees you, that no one understands. But the spirit of God is saying, I see you. I know you. I understand you, and I am with you. You are not alone. I have sent a community. I have sent people. I have sent help. 1 Peter 5:6-7. Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time. Cast all your anxiety on him, for he cares for you. Do you hear that? He cares for you. Not in theory, not in general, but for you specifically, for your situation specifically, for your need specifically. Let me speak to the children. The young ones. There are children whose futures are being targeted, whose destinies are being contested, whose gifts are being suppressed. But I decree protection over them. I decree preservation of their purpose. I decree that they grow up to fulfill the call of God on their lives, that they are shielded from the attacks of the enemy, that they are surrounded by wisdom and by grace. Psalm 91:11-12. For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways. They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone. Angels are assigned to your children right now, at this very moment. Angels are guarding them. Angels are protecting them. Angels are watching over them. Someone is in authority, in leadership, in a place of influence, and there is pressure on you. There is resistance. There are people who do not believe in your vision. There are people who are working against you. But the spirit of God is saying you have an anointing that is stronger than the resistance. You have a mandate that is greater than the opposition. I decree that you lead with wisdom, that you lead with authority, that you lead with compassion, and that those who oppose you will see the hand of God and will submit. Proverbs 21:1. The king's heart is a water channel in the hand of the Lord. He directs it where he chooses. If you are in any position of authority, if you are leading in any capacity, God is directing you. God is guiding you. Trust him. There is someone, and shame has been your companion. Wherever you go, it follows you. Whatever you do, it whispers. But the spirit of God is saying, shame does not belong to you. Shame was taken by Jesus at the cross. When he died, he died with all your shame. When he rose, he rose victorious over shame. And if you are in him, you are free from shame. Isaiah 54:4. Do not be afraid. You will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace. You will not be humiliated. This is the promise. This is the covenant. This is what God declares over you. Let me speak something that the spirit is burning in my heart. There is a realm of the supernatural that has been closed off from many believers. You do not see miracles. You do not see wonders. You do not see the manifest presence of God in your life, but the spirit of God is saying that realm is opening. I speak the opening of supernatural sight. The opening of divine encounters. The opening of miracles in your home, in your workplace, in your family. Hebrews 10:35. Do not throw away your confidence. It has great reward. Do not lose faith. Do not give up. Your breakthrough is waiting. Your miracle is approaching. Your answered prayer is coming. Someone is hearing this and you are being rejected by family, by friends, by the system, and that rejection has wounded you deeply. But the spirit of God is saying, "I accept you. I receive you. I embrace you. You are welcomed in the kingdom. You have a place here. You belong here." John 1:12. Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God. You are a child of God. That is your identity. That is your inheritance. That is your reality. There is a business and it is struggling. It is not growing. It is not thriving. But I decree acceleration. I decree increase. I decree divine customers. I decree that your doors are open. That your contacts are activated. That your products or services are recognized and rewarded. 3 John verse 2. I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you even as your soul is getting along well. Prosperity is God's desire for you. It is not selfish. It is not sinful. It is his will for you to prosper. I want to release something now. I want to speak directly to the spirit of procrastination. The spirit that says later. The spirit that says not now. The spirit that steals your momentum. Spirit of procrastination, I command you out. I speak that every person under the sound of my voice rises up and does what needs to be done. That you stop waiting. That you stop delaying. That you take action. That you move. That you step forward. Someone has been called into a new season, but you are afraid to step. You are afraid of failure. You are afraid of the unknown. You are afraid of what people will think. But the spirit of God is saying, "Fear is a liar. Fear is a thief. Fear steals your future, but faith faith activates your future." I speak the activation of faith. The release of faith. The manifestation of faith in your life. Hebrews 11:1. Now faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what we do not see. Faith is not blind. Faith is not foolish. Faith is certainty. Faith is knowing. Faith is conviction. Do you have that faith? If not, I am speaking it into existence right now over your life.
